068.note: Listing relocation logistics: listings.logistics jsonb not null default '{}' — the typed, evidence-honest home for the facts that decide whether an opportunity is livable (connectivity first: available/cost/where/access/type/approx speeds/reliability/data caps/video-call suitability/host-reported date). Follows the migration-040 precedent (ONE additive jsonb typed by packages/contracts, chosen over ~20 new columns on an already-47-column table) and the evidence model of 064: KEY ABSENCE IS 'not_stated' — a field the host never stated has no key, renders 'Not stated', and is never inferred, defaulted, or ranked over. Additive/idempotent; apply via db-migrate pipeline on merge — never applied by agents.

069.note: Category-scoped listing depth: listings.category_depth jsonb not null default '{}' — the facts that only matter for one lane (maritime first: vessel type/length, whether you sleep aboard, berth privacy, crew size, host-reported date). Keyed by category, typed by packages/contracts, key-absence IS 'not_stated' per 068. Deliberately a SECOND column rather than a key on 068's logistics: the two groups have independent host-reported dates, and a shared sanitize/diff would let editing a vessel fact stamp a fresh connectivity date — claiming the host re-confirmed a speed they never touched. G7 ('ONE listing object across categories; no per-category tables') is honored — this IS the listing row. listing_relevance_extensions was considered and REJECTED: its only write policy is listing_id in current_host_listing_ids(), which can never match a sourced listing (064 dropped host_profile_id NOT NULL), so depth on the launch inventory would silently write zero rows; and its default-true display_enabled/matching_enabled + default-0 completion_score make a bare row assert four claims the host never made, unfixable additively. NOT filterable — matching a category fact requires promoting it to a typed column per the 051 rule. Additive/idempotent; apply via db-migrate pipeline on merge — never applied by agents.
